Kit summary

Ghostly Blood SealActive
Deals 2 stages of DMG to one enemy: Bleed DMG equal to 12% of Izanami's Max HP, then HP Deduction DMG equal to 12% of her Max HP.
Netherworld BlessingActive
Grants HP Up II and ATK Up II to all allies for 2 turns, deals Bleed DMG equal to 5% of Izanami's Max HP to 3 random enemies, then grants all allies a non-removable Shield (30% of her Max HP) for 2 turns. If she has Ghost Attendant, restores 20% of her Max HP to all allies.
Netherworld Edict Lv.1Cast once at the start of each wave. When it damages non-Boss units, all allies perform 1 Basic ATK as a pursuit; allies without Ghost Attendant take 20% reduced DMG and allies with it deal 20% increased DMG for 2 turns.
Netherworld Edict Lv.2When an ally gains Ghost Attendant, this skill's and Netherworld Domain's cooldowns are reduced by 1 turn.
Ghost ServicePassive
When an ally deals DoT (Poison, Bleed, Burn, Internal Injury, HP Burning) via Basic ATK or Skill and then deals HP Deduction DMG, grants 1 layer of Ghost Attendant (+20% Skill DMG and Mastery, -40% DEF; max 3 layers per ally, at most 3 allies at once). Consecutive DoT interrupts later HP Deduction checks. Each Ghost Attendant gives Izanami +5% Max HP.
Netherworld Edict Lv.2When an ally gains Ghost Attendant, Izanami gains 20% Turn Meter (up to 3 times). Allies with Ghost Attendant are immune to the next 3 non-Boss DMG or control effects (refreshes each turn). At battle start, if the highest-ATK ally has HP Deduction, they gain 100% Turn Meter, Control Immunity for 1 turn and immunity to Turn Meter reduction and Skill CD increase. First time 3 allies have Ghost Attendant: enemies whose recorded DMG exceeds current HP lose HP equal to it, allies gain 50% Tenacity and Mastery RES (up to 3 layers, 2 turns) after casting a skill, and all allies gain 1 Ghost Gate Rebirth (on fatal DMG: removes controls, +30% Turn Meter, restores all HP); Ghost Attendant allies gain 2 additional layers.
Netherworld DomainUltimate
Grants Entwined Ghost Grudge to all enemies for 2 turns (when taking Poison, Bleed, Burn, Internal Injury or HP Burning DMG, also takes HP Deduction DMG equal to 4% of Izanami's Max HP, up to 5 times before acting). Then deals 2 stages to all enemies: Bleed DMG then HP Deduction DMG, each 12% of her Max HP.
Netherworld Edict Lv.3Cast once at battle start. Also deals 1 stage of Burn DMG equal to 10% of her Max HP with a 50% chance to Stun for 2 turns. Hitting non-Boss units cleanses allies' control effects and gives all allies +10% Turn Meter. Per deployed Bleed ally, Entwined Ghost Grudge increases Boss Bleed DMG taken by 5% and reduces their Direct DMG by 5%.
Netherworld Edict (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.
